source_correction: The inherited tile-0-13 static reference is a placeholder. Native PaintedWall=wall_metal uses256installed eight-neighbor masks, all now extracted privately. Cardinal examples are shown for the16ledger layouts.

facts: PaintedWall appends N,NE,E,SE,S,SW,W,NW binary flags after a dash. Default Tiles prefix and .bmp extension apply.
PaintWith=MetalWalls governs native joins. Material is not linked to unrelated fences/wood automatically.

palette.rule: Opaque source R0 is rust-metal foreground; R255 is pale-cyan edging. Transparent cells remain background, not a black fill.

donor_reference.role: Actual Wall_Atlas_Smooth supplies restrained bevel, metal shading and connected-atlas presentation only. Qud diamond pattern, lower industrial bracing, native geometry and r/C colors remain authoritative; no donor atlas order is copied.

construction: Native source contour and color-role cells own frame/base/bracing. Checker-region nodes retain their source positions, reconstructed as diamond joints linked by thin welded diagonal struts. Geometry is source-constrained and deterministic; ImageGen supplies only neutral material.
material: Editable neutral sheet-metal sample with restrained diagonal welded/diamond pattern, scratches and scorch marks. One material refinement supplies surface detail; native masks retain shape and color ownership.

frame.rule: Identical full-cell mapping for all256states. No state-specific alpha crop/recenter. No per-cell border caps or outline added on connected edges.

views: All256native painted states plus a16cardinal recipient atlas. No creature turnarounds, clothing or arbitrary rotations apply.
native_behavior: Solid metal/occluding state, damage/graffiti, visibility and paintability remain native. Appearance alpha does not authorize new see-through navigation/line-of-sight behavior.
native_acceptance: Deferred until every conversion is generated

supersedes_authoring_interpretation.reason: Literal checker enlargement produced disconnected squares. Preserve source nodes/frame/braces but reconstruct a coherent welded diamond mesh between those nodes; this is an authored interpretation, not exact native alpha preservation.
